description: Aménagements cyclables is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Lunel Agglo. Cycling facilities by Lunel Agglo. Go to the Lunel Agglo website for more information. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Lunel Agglo. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling facilities" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Lunel Agglo. Its keywords include mobilite, tourisme, lunel-agglo, nature, paysage, velo. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-07-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
